verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS analytics platform, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for event subscription. The related evidence does not qualify: Slack alerts (pendo-docs-10) are chat-app notifications, Data Sync exports to Snowflake or cloud storage (pendo-docs-6, -7) are a different capability, and the REST APIs shown are inbound (pendo-docs-20, -22).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
